It's a national lobby group that was approved by the party, actually for young people to
move around especially that the Congresses have started.
To move around and talk to stakeholders in the party about inclusion of young people from
the various levels that is from the world level of the government and state level.
We have a president, a vice president and leaders of the party who are very open to this
